body.name: Uniform-normalization handle \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{norm}}\)
body.construction: Run the published IDENTIFY\({}^{+}\) ancestor-district recursion with symbolic request literals, partition the finite valuations only by induced equality type, and prove that a successful selected source and restriction path persist under every refinement of those symbolic values. The selected source remains outside the universal quantifier over \(\Omega_j\).
